answer: Proposal: max-flow trust weighting. Audited seed anchors issue capacity-limited vouch edges; each identity's epoch weight equals the max-flow from anchors to it. Aliases lotus and sparrow add only internal edges, so the flow delta per clone is zero: headcount gains nothing without fresh honest-side attack edges, which are cut on proven fraud. Assumes honest anchor majority plus fraud review; fooled or purchased edges erode the bound linearly in their count.
